capabilities: Create tasks quickly with due dates, priorities, and auto-added tags
Display tasks in list, kanban, calendar, and timeline (including Gantt) views
Filter, sort, and group tasks by status, priority, tags, and dates
Track subtask progress with unlimited nesting
Toggle task completion by dragging between kanban columns
disambiguation: Despite the name, no AI is involved; tasks are standard Markdown checkboxes with emoji metadata and the "smart" part refers to query and filtering.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README states it makes no network requests or telemetry and stores all data in the vault. Demo section is empty, so no screenshots are actually available.
problem: Obsidian's core task checkboxes give no dedicated views, quick-capture workflow, or filtering and grouping over tasks across the vault.
summary: Task management plugin that stores tasks as Markdown checkboxes and offers list, kanban, calendar, and timeline views with filtering and queries.
